title: 🧊 3D Shape Volume & Surface Area Calculator
description: Pick a solid, type its dimensions and watch it rebuild in 3D. Get the volume, total and lateral surface area, capacity in litres and gallons, diagonals and slant heights — with the formula and work...
formula: Prisms and cylinders all share V = base area × height . Pyramids and cones are exactly a third of that: V = ⅓ ×
